from itertools import accumulate
from math import gcd


def best_average(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    P = list(accumulate(a, initial=0))
    q: list[int] = []
    head = 0
    best_p = -1
    best_q = 1

    for r in range(k, n + 1):
        i = r - k
        Pi = P[i]
        while len(q) - head >= 2:
            x1 = q[-2]
            x2 = q[-1]
            if (P[x2] - P[x1]) * (i - x2) >= (Pi - P[x2]) * (x2 - x1):
                q.pop()
            else:
                break
        q.append(i)

        Pr = P[r]
        while len(q) - head >= 2:
            x1 = q[head]
            x2 = q[head + 1]
            if (Pr - P[x1]) * (r - x2) <= (Pr - P[x2]) * (r - x1):
                head += 1
            else:
                break

        l = q[head]
        num = Pr - P[l]
        den = r - l
        if num * best_q > best_p * den:
            best_p = num
            best_q = den

    g = gcd(best_p, best_q)
    return [best_p // g, best_q // g]
